title: Predication hyperdoctrine
description: Predicate logic in bilattice values over a fiber algebra A_p = (L x L)^(E x E). For each predicate-category generator there is a reindexing (substitution) functor f* on the fibers, with an existential left adjoint and a universal right adjoint: exists_f -| f* -| forall_f. The reindexing morphism verifies, over the bilattice truth order: converse f* is an involution and a bilattice morphism; for subject/object projection the quantifiers are truth-join/meet over the projected-out entity and satisfy the two Galois adjunctions. This is what makes predication a logic (substitution + quantifiers), in a general value algebra.

generators.description: The reindexing generators whose substitution + adjoints have been verified on this fiber.
